decisions.reason: As a small accessory with low carrying cost, it is worth keeping on the market another year while demand uncertainty resolves.
Its home-page placement suggests strategic relevance in the firm's core trailer range, so the option value of waiting is still high.
This is a more specialized trailer with somewhat narrower demand, but after only one year there is still not enough evidence to justify abandonment.
A low-bed trailer series fits the established business closely and prominent presentation indicates a relatively strong commitment to continue.
The product complements the trailer portfolio and is likely inexpensive to keep available, so management would preserve the option for now.
Because it overlaps with another box car trailer series its pruning risk is higher, but with limited time on the market the firm would likely continue observing it rather than drop it immediately.
